column1: Tab 10 — Capacity Bands, Traffic Lights and Safety Modifiers

The 16-cell State Grid (Energy x Mood only) sets the BASELINE band. Experience and Context can only LOWER it, for safety - never raise it within a check-in. Emotions, intensity and sensations also shape WHAT is recommended (Tab 2), but they are never part of the matrix itself. Every threshold is an MVP starting point and must be tunable configuration. Traffic lights: Green, Yellow, Amber and a MUTED red (no bright or saturated red, to avoid sensory discomfort), plus a Blue Recovery light, following the Positive Behaviour Support idea of a recovery phase. Colour is never the only signal: every light also shows its label and an icon.
